neighbours.label: Best guess: ' a' in 'in the form of a', and ' J' before initials in a name given as 'named for'; other words in those slots stay lower, on a broad pole.
fire: It came with a pin in the form of a silver star.
The prize was a clasp in the form of a gold lion.
She wore a brooch in the form of a small bird.
He gave her a ring in the form of a snake.
One valley is named for J.K. Rowling, the author.
A crater was named for J.M. Barrie, the writer.
The asteroid is named for J.D. Salinger, they said.
One street is named for J.P. Morgan, the banker.
quiet: It came with a pin and a silver star.
The prize was a clasp of gold.
She wore a brooch on her coat.
He gave her a ring in the form of two snakes.
One valley is named for its river, they say.
A crater was named after the moon.
The asteroid is small, they said.
One street is named Morgan, like the banker.

notes: A broad pole (1.3%), mostly code on the card. Probes: ' a' 0.33, ' J' 0.20, ' =' 0.18, ' word' 0.10. May fail on the median.
